clips.title: Trying on a Sweater
grammar: 〜てくる — change of state over time
〜て重宝する — to come in handy

lines.ja: これから寒うなるからな、セーターは重宝すんで。
lines.en: It's gonna get cold from now on, so a sweater'll come in handy.
lines.speaker: Brown Cat

lines.ja: とってもお似合いですよ！
lines.en: It looks very good on you!
lines.speaker: Shop Clerk

lines.ja: 首のとこ締め付けられてキモいにゃ。
lines.en: It's tight around my neck and feels gross, nya.
lines.speaker: Yanineko

clips.title: Only Three Hundred Yen
grammar: 〜しかない — have no choice but / only have

lines.ja: ご、ごめんなさい！ボロ布だと思って…
lines.en: I-I'm sorry! I thought it was a rag...
lines.speaker: Shop Clerk

lines.ja: ま、まあ似たようなもんやしな。
lines.en: W-Well, it's pretty much the same thing.
lines.speaker: Brown Cat

lines.ja: しゃあない。ヤニねこ、なんか服買うて帰ろ。
lines.en: Can't be helped. Yanineko, let's buy some clothes and go home.
lines.speaker: Brown Cat

lines.en: What did you even come here for?!
lines.speaker: Brown Cat

clips.title: That's Not Being Clumsy!
grammar: 〜てしまう — expressing regret or completion

lines.ja: 臭かったんで、ゴミ箱じゃなくてガソリンで完全に炭にしてしまいました…
lines.en: It smelled bad, so instead of the trash bin, I used gasoline to burn it completely to ash...
lines.speaker: Shop Clerk

lines.en: Are you out of your mind?!
lines.speaker: Brown Cat

lines.ja: お前、人の服にガソリンで火ぃつける行為をドジって認識しとんのか！？
lines.en: You consider lighting someone's clothes on fire with gasoline being "clumsy"?!
lines.speaker: Brown Cat
